subject: POC trial — performance SLAs, quality gauges & owner commitments
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Collins <sara.collins@quantumai.com>, Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@quantumai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO C trial — performance SLAs, quality gauges & owner commitments

Hi Sara / Tom — great call this morning. Quick recap + proposed trial plan so we have a single reference as we prep infra and the workload handoff.

Top-line objective
- Validate that Redwood inference can meet QuantumAI’s latency and cost targets for the summarization pipeline on your sample corpus, while preserving extractive fidelity (business-critical).

Trial window
- 2 weeks (target start: 2025-06-09) — includes smoke, full-load run, and a short regression pass after tuning.

Success criteria (decision gates) — agree these as pass/fail for rollout:
1) Latency: P95 generation latency <= 250 ms for 8k context summarization (measured at your typical request distribution)
2) Throughput: sustained 180–220 req/s for the real-time path with <5% tail amplification
3) Cost: token cost <= $0.0009/token for the chosen model profile (pre-quantization) and <= $0.0006/token after applying suggested quantization if quality holds
4) Quality: business-acceptance by your SMEs — automated eval target >= 92% top-1 extractive match on the 1,000-sample human-labeled set; no more than 4% regression on secondary metrics (ROUGE-L and semantic similarity)

Evaluation plan and ownership
- QuantumAI: provide sample_workload.jsonl (10k requests) + traffic_profile_week.csv (deadline: 2025-06-02).
- Redwood (Ben): baseline run, profiling, kernel selection, and cost/latency breakdowns. Weekly dashboards and token-level cost breakdowns.
- Redwood (Monica): operational runbook, KV-prefix cache config, and hot-fix/playback run during smoke.

Attachments: I attached a short runbook (redwood-poc-runbook.pdf) and a template workload.

Next immediate steps
- Sara: confirm workload delivery by 2025-06-02 and any blocked redaction/anonymization steps.
- Tom: confirm if production-like keys / environment will be available for the full-load run (or if we should use a mirrored staging environment).
- Ben / Monica / I will schedule a 60-min kickoff on 2025-06-09.

Happy to adjust any of the gates above — flagged the ones I think matter most for your product SLA questions.

Thanks,
Priyom
Priyom Das
Enterprise Solutions 
Redwood Inference

From: Sara Collins <sara.collins@quantumai.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 May 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO C trial — performance SLAs, quality gauges & owner commitments

Priyom — thanks for the thorough note and quick turnaround. Confirming a few items from our side:

- We can deliver the sample_workload.jsonl (10k) and traffic_profile_week.csv by EOD 2025-06-01 — we’ll include a small redaction map (PHI/PII) so you can mirror anonymization steps.
- We’d prefer the full-load run on a staging environment that mirrors production keys but with limited write privileges. I’ll confirm infra access by 2025-06-04.
- Quality target: our SME team is comfortable with the 92% top-1 threshold as a starting bar; if you see consistent regressions we’ll do a manual triage pass during week 2.

Question on cost math: the delta between pre/post-quantization looks reasonable. Can Ben call out what quantization modes you’ll test (int8 vs awq-4/3)? Also — any guidance on tokenization differences that could impact cost calc?

We’ll be available for the 2025-06-09 kickoff; Tom will manage access.

—Sara
Sara Collins
Head of Product
QuantumAI

Adding a few engineering specifics to answer Sara’s quantization/tokenization questions and set realistic measurement methods:

Quantization modes we’ll bench:
- AWQ-4 (fastest inference path, good quality for summarization)
- INT8 with per-channel calibration (lower memory, risk of slight quality drift)
- Baseline FP16 for parity and delta measurement

Tokenization notes:
- We’ll run the workload with both your tokenizer and our internal canonical tokenizer to measure token counts and normalize cost-per-output. If there’s a discrepancy >6% in token counts, we’ll report adjusted cost numbers and recommend canonicalization steps.

Measurement plan (metrics and artifact delivery):
- Baseline profile: 1k sample run (Ben) — will deliver a profile CSV with per-request latency, token_in/out, and memory utilization by 2025-06-11.
- Full-load run: 10k sample run under your traffic profile — we’ll produce a dashboard link and an artifacts.zip with logs, kernel selection summary, and per-token cost breakdown by 2025-06-18.

Operational responsibilities:
- Monica: will lead smoke run and escalation playbook (on-call for trial window).
- Ben: tuning, quantization experiments, and performance validation; I will flag any tradeoffs where cost savings cause >1.5% quality drop.
- Priyom: commercial/regulatory touchpoints and final acceptance gate.

Attachment: initial profiling script (we’ll post to the Drive link once you share workload).

If that looks good I’ll scope the AWQ and INT8 runs so we can estimate time and compute needs for billing.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Sr. Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Thanks everyone — quick confirmation and a small update to acceptance gates after Ben’s notes:

Updated acceptance gates (final):
- Latency: P95 <= 250 ms (measured with QuantumAI tokenization)
- Throughput: sustained 180–220 req/s under the provided traffic profile
- Cost: <= $0.0009/token baseline; target <= $0.0006/token with quantization but only if automated eval stays within 1.5% quality variance of baseline
- Quality: automated eval >= 92% top-1 + SME signoff on a 300-sample adjudication set (sample drawn by QuantumAI)

Operational cadence
- Kickoff: 2025-06-09 09:00 PT (60 min) — agenda: workload handoff, infra access, smoke run checklist, and reporting cadence.
- Midpoint review: 2025-06-13 (15 min) — first full-load summary and any immediate blockers.
- Final readout & decision: 2025-06-18 (30–45 min)

If QuantumAI can share the workload by 2025-06-01 and confirm staging access by 2025-06-04, we’ll lock compute and send an estimate for the small trial billing line item (Ben will include compute hours and AWQ/INT8 experiment time).

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.

Priyom
Priyom Das
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
